Theorem
[Arzelà--Ascoli Theorem] ↗ def:uniform-equicontinuity 1. appC:thm-9\group Uniform Convergence

Let $\{ f_k\} _{k=1}^\infty $ be real-valued functions on $\mathbb R^n$. Assume that some $M$ satisfies \[ |f_k(x)|\leq M \qquad (k=1,2,\ldots ,\ x\in \mathbb R^n), \] and that the family is uniformly equicontinuous. Then there are a subsequence $\{ f_{k_j}\} _{j=1}^\infty $ and a continuous function $f$ such that \[ f_{k_j}\to f \quad \text{uniformly on compact subsets of }\mathbb R^n. \]
